components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Gold button for search, play, retry, and other primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .55rem; padding: 0 1.1rem; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--yt-ink); background: var(--yt-gold); font: 700 .95rem/1.5 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s ease, background-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #f0cd67; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9b7410; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .58; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Icon Secondary Button
components.description: Square secondary action for add, skip, or remove controls.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Add to queue"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--yt-ink); background: var(--yt-surface); cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: var(--yt-gold-soft); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9b7410; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-icon { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Wide search field within the outlined search panel.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="Search songs, creators, and more" aria-label="Search videos" />
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 52px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--yt-ink); background: var(--yt-surface); font: 400 1rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--yt-muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9b7410; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Brand Navigation
components.description: White top bar with gold play mark and local session status.
components.html: youtuiConnected
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 68px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 clamp(1rem, 5vw, 5rem); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--yt-line); background: var(--yt-surface); } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; color: var(--yt-ink); font: 800 1.2rem 'Manrope', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.03em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9b7410; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-brand-mark { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 9px; color: var(--yt-ink); background: var(--yt-gold); } .ds-nav-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; color: var(--yt-muted); font: 400 .875rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-status i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--yt-gold); }

components.name: Queue Count Chip
components.description: Inline gold count beside the queue heading.
components.css: .ds-chip-count { display: inline-grid; min-width: 24px; height: 24px; place-items: center; margin-left: .2rem; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--yt-ink); background: var(--yt-gold); font: 600 .75rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; vertical-align: 2px; }

components.name: Result Card
components.description: Compact result row with clear outline and restrained hover lift in depth.
components.html: Video titleChannel name · 4:20
components.css: .ds-card-result { display: flex; min-height: 88px; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; padding: .65rem; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 11px; background: var(--yt-surface); box-shadow: 0 2px 7px #191a2309; transition: border-color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-card-result:hover { background: #fffdf5; box-shadow: 0 4px 11px #191a2314, 0 2px 0 #191a230c; } .ds-card-art { display: grid; width: 76px; height: 58px; flex: 0 0 76px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--yt-surface-soft); } .ds-card-art span { display: grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--yt-gold); } .ds-card-copy { display: grid; flex: 1; min-width: 0; gap: .2rem; color: var(--yt-ink); font: 400 .95rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card-copy small { overflow: hidden; color: var(--yt-muted); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-icon { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: 0 0 44px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--yt-ink); background: var(--yt-surface); cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: var(--yt-gold-soft); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9b7410; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card-result, .ds-btn-icon { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Settings Switch
components.description: Outlined pill switch with a gold enabled track and moving ink thumb.
components.css: .ds-switch-row { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: .6rem 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e4de; color: var(--yt-ink); background: transparent; font: 600 .9rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9b7410; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-switch { display: flex; width: 40px; height: 24px; flex: 0 0 40px; align-items: center; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 99px; background: #d7d7d0; transition: background-color .18s ease; } .ds-switch i { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px #191a2340; transition: transform .18s ease; } .ds-switch-on { background: var(--yt-gold); } .ds-switch-on i { transform: translateX(15px); background: var(--yt-ink); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-switch, .ds-switch i { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

components.name: Preparation State
components.description: Gold-tinted player status that names the selected video during preparation.
components.html: Selected videoPreparing this video for playback.
components.css: .ds-preparing { display: grid; gap: .2rem; margin: .75rem 0 0; padding: .7rem .8rem; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 9px; color: var(--yt-gold-ink); background: var(--yt-gold-soft); font: 400 .95rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-preparing strong { color: var(--yt-ink); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-preparing span { font-size: .9rem; }

components.name: Theater Toggle
components.description: Player control for switching to the wide theater layout; this sample shows the pressed state.
components.css: .ds-theater-toggle { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .4rem; padding: .4rem .65rem; border: 1px solid var(--yt-ink); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--yt-ink); background: var(--yt-surface); font: 600 .85rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease; } .ds-theater-toggle:hover { background: var(--yt-gold-soft); } .ds-theater-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--yt-gold); } .ds-theater-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9b7410; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-theater-toggle { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
Youtui is a local video workspace. Its browser interface keeps search, results, the player, and queue visible as parts of one utility. It adapts the user's Positivus reference with light surfaces, dark outlines, gold highlights, and restrained offset shadows. It is not a marketing landing page.

DM Sans carries interface text and Manrope marks the brand and headings. The layout keeps the results beside the player on wide screens, then stacks the workspace on narrow screens. The interface names preparation and error states next to the player and keeps browser video controls native.
keyCharacteristics: Light paper-like page with white work surfaces.
Dark outlines and gold controls provide clear boundaries and actions.
Search, results, playback, queue, and settings share one workspace.

rules.name: The Result Containment Rule
rules.body: The results list and each card can shrink within their grid tracks. Text truncates before the artwork or action buttons shrink.

dos: Do keep the interface light, with dark outlines and gold action emphasis.
Do retain DM Sans and Manrope for the existing interface roles.
Do keep visible keyboard focus and readable control targets.
Do show preparation and recovery state beside the player.
Do stack the workspace at narrow widths and preserve its search-to-play flow.
donts: Don't turn the player into a marketing landing page.
Don't use green as the interface accent; the approved adaptation uses gold.
Don't replace the native browser video controls with a custom player skin.
